Calculate wall thickness stress where pressure P = 2.5 MPa, inner radius r = 1200 mm, thickness t = 24 mm using formula sigma = P * r / (2 * t)

The wall thickness stress ($\sigma$) is calculated using the formula:
$$\sigma = \frac{P \cdot r}{2 \cdot t}$$

Plugging in the values:
*   $P = 2.5 \text{ MPa}$
*   $r = 1200 \text{ mm}$
*   $t = 24 \text{ mm}$

$$\sigma = \frac{2.5 \cdot 1200}{2 \cdot 24} = \frac{3000}{48} = 62.5$$

The wall thickness stress is **62.5 MPa**.
